title: BPW-2026-0587
text:
[CONSENT ITEM]
BPW-2026-0587
Specification submitted for Board adoption and authorization to advertise for the Invitation of Bids:
CD 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 12, 13
Vision Zero Phase 2H, Backlog Reduction Phase 3 & Reap 2.0 Traffic Signal Improvements
W.O.: E1909558
Estimate: $17,759,497
Bid Receipt Date: Wednesday, December 16, 2026
summary: The Board of Public Works is asking to advertise bids for traffic signal improvements under Vision Zero Phase 2H, Backlog Reduction Phase 3 and Reap 2.0, covering nine council districts. The estimate is $17,759,497, and bids are due December 16, 2026.

details.action: Authorize invitation for bids on traffic signal improvements
